messages:
emma: Quick sync item 1: we27re shipping audit schema v3 that changes some KMS event names and adds RBAC resource normalization. Need a customer-facing mapping doc + short changelog. Who can own doc + SIEM examples?
matt: I can own the doc. Can you list the exact field additions/renames and the rollout schedule? Will this be auto-applied everywhere?
emma: TL;DR: hosted flips on 2026-04-15, dedicated gets an opt-in starting 2026-04-22, private gets the schema docs and patch notes only (no automatic change). Key schema changes: added actor.principal_id (service principal canonical id), normalized resource.type values (e.g., kms_key -> kms_key), grouped KMS events under kms.* (previously various key.rotate/key.create names), and event.correlation_id for cross-service traces.
dan: Mapping examples I'm proposing (concise):
- old: key.rotate -> new: kms.key_rotated
- old: key.create -> new: kms.key_created
- old: user.update_role -> new: rbac.role_assigned (with rbac.action enum: assign/revoke)

Also adding actor.principal_id for any non-user actor (svc- prefixed). Example payload (for docs):
```json
{
  "event": "kms.key_rotated",
  "actor": { "id": "u-42", "principal_id": "svc.123" },
  "resource": { "type": "kms_key", "id": "key-abc" },
  "event.correlation_id": "corr-987",
  "tenant_id": "t-001"
}
```

sophie: Customers requested a one-page migration cheat-sheet + SIEM query snippets for Splunk and Elastic. Can we include a downloadable CSV mapping (old_event,new_event,changed_fields,splunk_example)?
matt: Good idea. CSV columns: old_event,new_event,notes,example_query_splunk,example_query_elastic. I27ll add two sample rows and a small FAQ.
dan: Splunk example to count rotations by tenant: 
```spl
index=redwood_audit event=kms.key_rotated | stats count by tenant_id, resource.id
```
Elastic (KQL) analogue: 
```kql
event: "kms.key_rotated" | stats count() by tenant_id, resource.id
```

emma: Important privacy/security Qs to include in FAQ: 
1) Do audit logs ever contain plaintext key material? NO. KMS events only surface key IDs and metadata (not key material).
2) Will we backfill historical events? NO backfill; however for hosted we27ll provide a translation layer in the logs exporter so existing sinks can optionally get translated event names for a short migration window. Dedicated/private customers will get the schema docs and guidance to update their exporters.

alex: Add a compatibility section in the doc: 
- header: \"Compatibility & migration options\"
- bullet: hosted automatic translation layer (30 days post-flip)
- bullet: dedicated opt-in exporter flag (docs + CLI flag)
- bullet: private: manual migration only (we provide mapping tables and examples).

matt: Drafting the changelog entries: 
- 2026-04-15: Audit schema v3 enabled for hosted (event name normalization; new fields actor.principal_id, event.correlation_id)
- 2026-04-22: Dedicated opt-in rollout begins
- Private: docs & examples published same day as dedicated opt-in
I27ll include a short example CSV and a Splunk/Elastic snippet for each mapping.

sophie: I27ll prepare a CSM email template highlighting: what changes, why (better SIEM consistency + tracing), timeline, and action items: test queries, update alerts/dashboards, opt-in steps for dedicated. Ping me when draft is ready.
emma: FYI: audit consumers asked about RBAC resource IDs format. We normalized resource.id to be globally consistent (tenant scoped IDs). Add a sample mapping and note that older events had varying id formats.
dan: Suggest adding an internal checklist for support/CSMs: 
- Provide sample queries for common use cases (key rotations, role changes, KMS access failures).
- Provide short globs for log filters (e.g., event:kms.*)
- Provide rollback guidance (how to flip exporter translation off).

matt: Will include checklist + internal note for on-call. Also adding a short \"how to validate\" section with steps: pull a live event, verify presence of actor.principal_id and event.correlation_id, run the sample Splunk query.
emma: One more: security FAQ addition: will the actor.principal_id collide with user IDs? No - principal_id uses a svc.<num> namespace for non-user principals; human users keep existing id field. Call that out.

jira-bot: Created ticket SEC-AUDIT-312: docs + customer-mapping for audit schema v3. https://rwd/SEC-AUDIT-312

matt: I'll have a first draft in the docs repo tomorrow EOD. Tagging @sophie and @emma for review once it's up. :white_check_mark:
